tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

39	### 4.1 模块一：argparse 参数组结构
40	
41	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
42	
43	一个成熟的批处理工具往往有几十个命令行参数。如果全部平铺，`--help` 会变成一堵墙。argparse 提供了 `add_argument_group()`：把参数按「职责」分到不同小组，`--help` 输出就会按组显示小标题，读者可以按需只看自己关心的组。
44	
45	olmOCR 的参数按「流水线的执行地点」分成四大块：
46	
47	1. **顶层输入**（不属于任何组）：workspace 放哪、处理哪些 PDF、用什么模型——任何运行方式都需要回答的问题。
48	2. **Server 组**：推理引擎不在本机时，远程服务的地址和密钥。

50	4. **Beaker 组**：把任务提交到 AI2 的 Beaker 集群，而不是本地运行。
51	
52	这四组恰好对应 olmOCR 的四种运行形态：本地 GPU 跑、远程 API 跑、本地多卡跑、集群跑。
53	
54	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
55

60	  ├─ 位置参数 workspace（必填）
61	  ├─ --pdfs（可多个值）与 --model

64	  ├─ vllm_group：--gpu-memory-utilization、--max_model_len、-tp、-dp、--port
65	  └─ beaker_group：--beaker 系列

67	  ├─ args         ：已识别的参数，装进命名空间
68	  └─ unknown_args ：未识别的参数，留给 vLLM
69	```

143	
144	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
145	
146	默认值是作者对「典型场景」的预判：不传参数时，程序按最常见的方式运行。读懂默认值，等于读懂作者认为什么样的用法是主流。olmOCR 的默认值整体面向「本地/集群 GPU 大批量处理」场景：并发拉满、页组很大、重试次数充足。而一旦你走「外部按量计费 API」路线，就必须主动调小若干参数——README 甚至专门给了建议值。

148	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
149	
150	解析完成后，各默认值流向流水线的不同位置：
151	
152	```text

154	args.max_concurrent_requests=1600 → asyncio.BoundedSemaphore 限制同时在飞的请求数
155	args.max_model_len=16384 ─→ 拼进 "vllm serve" 命令行
156	args.port=30024 ─────────→ vllm serve 端口 + args.server 的 localhost 地址
157	args.stats / args.beaker ─→ 触发短路分支，提前 return

225	### 4.3 模块三：argparse.SUPPRESS 与条件默认值技巧
226	
227	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
228	
229	argparse 的普通 `default` 有个先天局限：**解析结束后属性一定存在**。比如 `default=None` 之后，你无法用 `args.pages_per_group is None` 之外的语义区分「用户没写」和「用户写了但值恰好等值」；更麻烦的是当合法值本身可能是 `0`、`False` 或 `None` 时，`if not args.xxx` 这类判断会把「用户显式传了 0」误判成「没传」。
230	
231	`argparse.SUPPRESS` 解决了这个问题：**未在命令行提供时，命名空间里干脆不创建这个属性**。于是 `hasattr(args, "pages_per_group")` 成为百分之百可靠的「用户是否显式设置」探测器。olmOCR 用它实现了一个精巧的条件默认值：`pages_per_group` 的最终默认值取决于用户有没有给 `--api_key`。
232	
233	此外，olmOCR 还展示了另外两个「解析之后再定值」的技巧，合起来构成一个家族：
234	
235	- `--disk_logging`：`nargs="?"` + `const` + `default=None` 三件套——「不写 flag」是 None，「只写 flag」是 `const` 值，「flag 带值」是那个值。
236	- `--server`：解析时无默认，随后在 `main()` 里根据它是否存在改写 `args.server` / `args.model`。
237	
238	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
239	
240	`pages_per_group` 的完整生命线：
241	
242	```text
243	argparse 定义：default=argparse.SUPPRESS
244	        ↓
245	parse_known_args()
246	        ├─ 用户写了 --pages_per_group N → args.pages_per_group = N（正常属性）
247	        └─ 用户没写                → args 上【没有】这个属性
248	        ↓
249	main() 检查：if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
250	        ├─ args.api_key is not None（走外部付费 API）→ 默认 50 页/组
251	        └─ 否则（本地/集群自有算力）      → 默认 500 页/组
252	        ↓
253	收集 --pdfs 时：采样最多 100 个 PDF 估算平均页数
254	        ↓
255	items_per_group = max(1, int(args.pages_per_group / 平均页数))
256	        ↓
257	populate_queue(paths, items_per_group) 切分工作项
258	```
259	
260	为什么外部 API 场景要调小？源码注释（L1312-L1313）给了两个理由：一是外部服务商并发限制低，大页组会「压垮服务器」；二是外部 API 按量计费，如果一个页组中途失败重跑，组越大浪费的钱越多。
261	
262	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
263	
264	SUPPRESS 的定义处：
265	
266	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1220](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1220) —— `--pages_per_group` 的 default 是 `argparse.SUPPRESS`，是全部参数中唯一一个。
267	
268	```python
269	parser.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
270	                    help="Aiming for this many pdf pages per work item group")
271	```
272	
273	条件默认值的赋值处（注意它发生在解析之后、任何使用之前）：
274	
275	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1312-L1315](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1312-L1315) —— 注释原话翻译：如果你提供了 API key（意味着你在用远程付费服务商），就调小组大小默认值，免得压垮服务器、也免得组跑不完时浪费钱。
276	
277	```python
278	# If you specify an API key, meaning you are on a remote provider, then lower the group size default...
279	if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
280	    args.pages_per_group = 50 if args.api_key is not None else 500
281	```

283	这个默认值最终被消费的地方：
284	
285	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1398-L1405](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1398-L1405) —— 先随机采样（最多 100 个）PDF 用 pypdf 数页数求平均，再按 `items_per_group = max(1, int(args.pages_per_group / avg_pages_per_pdf))` 计算每组打包几个 PDF。例如平均 10 页/份、目标 500 页/组，则每组约 50 份 PDF。
286	
287	`parse_known_args` 的另一半——unknown_args 的转发终点在 `vllm_server_task`：
288	
289	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L807-L834](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L807-L834) —— 先拼出基础命令（端口、tensor/data parallel、关掉 video 编码器省内存等），再按需追加 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 和 `--max-model-len`（都做了 `is not None` 判断），最后：

293	    cmd.extend(unknown_args)     # L833-L834：未识别参数原样追加
294	```

296	也就是说，你可以写 `olmocr ./ws --pdfs a.pdf --enforce-eager`——`--enforce-eager` 不是 olmocr 的参数，argparse 不会报错，它会出现在 `vllm serve ... --enforce-eager` 的末尾。这让 olmocr 无需为 vLLM 的每个新参数都改一遍自己的 argparse 定义，两个工具的参数空间直接打通。

298	同族技巧之 `--disk_logging`：
299	
300	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1232-L1239](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1232-L1239) —— `nargs="?"` 表示「该选项可以带值也可以不带」；不带值时用 `const` 指定的 `olmocr-pipeline-debug.log`；完全没写这个选项时是 `default` 的 `None`。于是一句 `--disk_logging` 就能开日志，`--disk_logging my.log` 则自定义文件名；消费点在 [L1275-L1280](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1275-L1280)，为两个 logger 挂上 DEBUG 级别的文件 handler。
301	
302	同族技巧之 `--server` 的三态：
303	
304	[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1286](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1286) —— `use_internal_server = not args.server`：提供了 `--server` 就用外部的，没提供就自己启动 vLLM。随后 [L1432-L1433](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1432-L1433) 直接**改写** `args` 命名空间：`args.server = f"http://localhost:{args.port}/v1"`、`args.model = "olmocr"`。下游代码（如构造请求 URL 的 [L161](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L161)）从此不必关心服务器是本地的还是远程的，统一读 `args.server`。`--api_key` 同样只在有 `--server` 时才生效（[L167](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L167)）。
305	
306	> 顺带一个可自行验证的细节：[L1282-L1284](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1282-L1284) 的提示日志让用户用下划线形式 `--gpu_memory_utilization 0.80`，而注册的选项名是连字符形式 `--gpu-memory-utilization`。不同 Python 版本的 argparse 对「下划线/连字符混写」的接受度不同，建议以 `olmocr --help` 实测为准（待本地验证）；写文档和脚本时用注册形式最稳妥。argparse 默认还支持无歧义的前缀缩写（如 `--max-model` 匹配 `--max-model-len`，前提是不与其他选项冲突）。
307	
308	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
309	
310	**实践目标**：用 10 行纯 Python 复现 `argparse.SUPPRESS` + 条件默认值机制，亲眼确认「没写就没有这个属性」。
311	
312	**操作步骤**：
313	
314	1. 把下面的脚本存为 `suppress_demo.py`（**示例代码**，不依赖 olmocr，任何 Python 3 均可运行）：
315	
316	```python
317	# 示例代码：复现 pipeline.py L1220 与 L1312-L1315 的机制
318	import argparse
319	
320	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
321	parser.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
322	parser.add_argument("--api_key", type=str, default=None)
323	
324	args = parser.parse_args()  # 不带任何参数运行
325	print("hasattr:", hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"))  # 预期 False
326	
327	if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
328	    args.pages_per_group = 50 if args.api_key is not None else 500
329	print("条件默认值:", args.pages_per_group)  # 预期 500
330	
331	# 对照组：普通 default=None 的属性永远存在
332	p2 = argparse.ArgumentParser()
333	p2.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=None)
334	print("default=None 时:", vars(p2.parse_args([])))  # 值存在且为 None
335	```
336	
337	2. 运行 `python suppress_demo.py`，记下三行输出。
338	3. 再分别运行 `python suppress_demo.py --pages_per_group 100` 和 `python suppress_demo.py --api_key sk-test`，观察输出如何变化。
339	
340	**需要观察的现象**：不带参数时 `hasattr` 为 `False`；加了 `--api_key` 后条件默认值变成 50；加了 `--pages_per_group 100` 后 `hasattr` 为 `True` 且值保持 100 不被覆盖。
341	
342	**预期结果**：三种运行的输出分别对应「本地默认 500」「外部 API 默认 50」「用户显式指定优先」。这正是 [L1312-L1315](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1312-L1315) 的行为模型。（本讲义写作环境未执行脚本，读者本地运行即得结果。）
343	
344	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
345	
346	**练习 1**：如果 `--pages_per_group` 改用 `default=None`，再用 `if args.pages_per_group is None` 判断，功能上可行吗？SUPPRESS 的额外价值是什么？
347	
348	**参考答案**：在本例中功能上可行（None 不是该参数的合法业务值）。SUPPRESS 的额外价值在于通用性：当某参数的合法值可能包含 `0`、`False`、`None` 时，`is None` 或 `if not x` 的哨兵判断会失真，而 `hasattr` 永远准确；它也把「属性不存在」这一信号显式暴露在类型层面，阅读代码的人一眼就知道这里有条件默认值逻辑。

350	**练习 2**：`olmocr ./ws --pdfs a.pdf --swap-space 4` 能正常运行吗？`--swap-space 4` 去了哪里？
351	
352	**参考答案**：能。`--swap-space` 不是 olmocr 注册的参数，`parse_known_args()` 把它收进 `unknown_args`；只要这次运行会启动内部 vLLM（没给 `--server`），[L833-L834](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L833-L834) 会把它追加到 `vllm serve` 命令末尾，最终由 vLLM 解释。若用了 `--server` 外部服务，`unknown_args` 则不会被使用（本地不启动 vLLM）。

354	**练习 3**：`--disk_logging` 不带值、带值、完全不写三种情形下，`args.disk_logging` 分别是什么？
355	
356	**参考答案**：分别为 `const` 值 `olmocr-pipeline-debug.log`、用户给的值（如 `my.log`）、`default` 值 `None`。三态来自 `nargs="?"` + `const` + `default` 的组合，定义在 [L1232-L1239](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1232-L1239)。

358	## 5. 综合实践
359	
360	**任务：为三种部署形态各写出一条「带注释的」完整 olmocr 命令，并预填参数表。**

362	1. **形态 A——本地 GPU**：单卡、16GB 显存紧张。写出命令并解决「KV cache 超显存」问题（提示：`--gpu-memory-utilization`、`--max_model_len`，参考 [L1282-L1284](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1282-L1284) 的提示与 [README.md:L274](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/README.md#L274) 的示例）。

367	
368	形态 B/C 的实际提交（API key、Beaker 账号）为待本地验证项；命令拼写与参数语义的核对在本机 `--help` 即可完成。

370	## 6. 本讲小结
371	
372	- olmOCR 的几十个 CLI 参数定义全部集中在 [pipeline.py:L1200-L1272](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1200-L1272)，按「顶层输入 / 详细配置 / Server / VLLM / Beaker」分组，恰好对应四种运行形态；`--help` 的分组小节与 `add_argument_group` 一一对应。

379	## 7. 下一步学习建议

# CLI 参数全解析：从 --help 回到 argparse 源码

## 1. 本讲目标

读完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 运行 `olmocr --help`，并把输出里的每一个参数与 [olmocr/pipeline.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py) 中 `main()` 的 argparse 定义一一对应。
2. 说出命令行参数的四个组——顶层输入、详细配置、Server（远程推理服务）、VLLM（本地推理引擎）、Beaker（集群提交）——各自控制流水线的哪一段。
3. 判断哪些参数影响**吞吐**（每秒能处理多少页）、哪些影响**成本**（外部 API 按量计费时花多少钱）、哪些影响**质量与容错**。
4. 掌握两个 argparse 进阶技巧：`parse_known_args()` 如何把「不认识的参数」原样转发给 vLLM，以及 `argparse.SUPPRESS` 如何实现「根据其他参数动态决定默认值」。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲假设你已经完成第 1 单元前几讲（尤其是 u1-l3 第一次运行）。需要用到的概念：

- **CLI（命令行接口）**：在终端里输入 `olmocr ./localworkspace --markdown --pdfs a.pdf` 这样的命令来驱动程序。
- **argparse**：Python 标准库里解析命令行参数的模块。你写 `parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=20)`，argparse 就负责把命令行里的 `--workers 5` 变成 Python 对象 `args.workers = 5`。
- **位置参数与可选参数**：`workspace` 不带 `--` 前缀、必须按顺序提供，叫位置参数；`--pdfs`、`--markdown` 这类带 `--` 的叫可选参数。
- **`dest` 属性名**：`--max-model-len` 里的连字符不是合法的 Python 标识符，argparse 会自动把它转成下划线，所以代码里访问的是 `args.max_model_len`。
- **`store_true`**：布尔开关。命令行里写了 `--markdown` 则 `args.markdown` 为 `True`，不写则为 `False`（默认值）。
- **workspace**：u1-l3 讲过的「工作区」，是所有中间状态和结果的存放目录；本讲的第一个位置参数就是它。
- 入口链路回顾：[pyproject.toml:L49-L50](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/pyproject.toml#L49-L50) 把 `olmocr` 命令注册到 `olmocr.pipeline:cli_main`，[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1526-L1528](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1526-L1528) 中的 `cli_main()` 再用 `asyncio.run(main())` 把异步的 `main()` 跑起来。参数解析就发生在 `main()` 的开头。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲关注的区域 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L1199-L1272 | `main()` 开头的 argparse 定义：位置参数、顶层选项、三个参数组、`parse_known_args()` |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L1275-L1289 | 解析后的立即消费：日志文件、并发信号量 |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L1312-L1315 | `pages_per_group` 的条件默认值（本讲核心技巧） |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L807-L834 | `vllm_server_task` 拼装 `vllm serve` 命令，`unknown_args` 在这里被转发 |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L1414-L1420、L1429-L1437 | `--stats` / `--beaker` 短路分支；内部服务器时改写 `args.server` |
| `olmocr/pipeline.py` | L1455-L1459 | `--workers` 决定拉起多少个 worker 协程 |
| `README.md` | L274-L349、L430-L491 | 官方使用示例、各云厂商推荐命令、一份 `--help` 快照 |
| `pyproject.toml` | L49-L50 | `olmocr` 命令的注册处 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块一：argparse 参数组结构

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

一个成熟的批处理工具往往有几十个命令行参数。如果全部平铺，`--help` 会变成一堵墙。argparse 提供了 `add_argument_group()`：把参数按「职责」分到不同小组，`--help` 输出就会按组显示小标题，读者可以按需只看自己关心的组。

olmOCR 的参数按「流水线的执行地点」分成四大块：

1. **顶层输入**（不属于任何组）：workspace 放哪、处理哪些 PDF、用什么模型——任何运行方式都需要回答的问题。
2. **Server 组**：推理引擎不在本机时，远程服务的地址和密钥。
3. **VLLM 组**：在本机（或容器内）自己启动 vLLM 推理引擎时的引擎级配置。
4. **Beaker 组**：把任务提交到 AI2 的 Beaker 集群，而不是本地运行。

这四组恰好对应 olmOCR 的四种运行形态：本地 GPU 跑、远程 API 跑、本地多卡跑、集群跑。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`main()` 的参数定义流程可以概括为：

```text
创建 ArgumentParser
  ├─ 位置参数 workspace（必填）
  ├─ --pdfs（可多个值）与 --model
  ├─ 一批"详细配置"选项（直接挂在 parser 上，出现在 --help 的 options 节）
  ├─ server_group：--server、--api_key
  ├─ vllm_group：--gpu-memory-utilization、--max_model_len、-tp、-dp、--port
  └─ beaker_group：--beaker 系列
parse_known_args() → (args, unknown_args)
  ├─ args         ：已识别的参数，装进命名空间
  └─ unknown_args ：未识别的参数，留给 vLLM
```

分组只影响 `--help` 的展示和源码组织，不影响参数的解析优先级；真正让「未识别参数」变得有用的是 `parse_known_args()`（见模块三）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

入口：`main()` 的第一行创建解析器，description 一句话点明工具定位——「跑百万级 PDF 的批处理流水线管理器」：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1200-L1215](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1200-L1215) 定义唯一的必填位置参数 `workspace`（本地目录或 `s3://` 前缀）、`--pdfs`（`nargs="*"` 允许一次给多个路径，shell 的 `*.pdf` 通配符也会展开成多个）和 `--model`（默认 `allenai/olmOCR-2-7B-1025-FP8`）。

```python
parser.add_argument(
    "workspace",
    help="The filesystem path where work will be stored, can be a local folder, or an s3 path ...",
)
parser.add_argument("--pdfs", nargs="*", help="Path to add pdfs ... can be a glob path s3://bucket/prefix/*.pdf ...", default=None)
```

接着是一批「通常不需要改」的详细配置，直接挂在 parser 上（源码注释原话是 *More detailed config options, usually you shouldn't have to change these*）：[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1217-L1239](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1217-L1239)，包括 `--workers`、`--max_concurrent_requests`、`--pages_per_group`（本讲主角，L1220 用了 `argparse.SUPPRESS`）、`--stats`、`--markdown`、`--disk_logging` 等十几个选项。

然后显式建组。Server 组服务「远程推理」场景：

### 4.2 模块二：关键默认值解读

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

默认值是作者对「典型场景」的预判：不传参数时，程序按最常见的方式运行。读懂默认值，等于读懂作者认为什么样的用法是主流。olmOCR 的默认值整体面向「本地/集群 GPU 大批量处理」场景：并发拉满、页组很大、重试次数充足。而一旦你走「外部按量计费 API」路线，就必须主动调小若干参数——README 甚至专门给了建议值。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

解析完成后，各默认值流向流水线的不同位置：

```text
args.workers=20 ──────────→ main() 里 for 循环创建 20 个 worker 协程
args.max_concurrent_requests=1600 → asyncio.BoundedSemaphore 限制同时在飞的请求数
args.max_model_len=16384 ─→ 拼进 "vllm serve" 命令行
args.port=30024 ─────────→ vllm serve 端口 + args.server 的 localhost 地址
args.stats / args.beaker ─→ 触发短路分支，提前 return
```

两个「短路开关」值得注意先后顺序：`--stats` 在 [olmocr/pipeline.py:L1414-L1416](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1414-L1416) 打印统计后直接 `return`，发生在 GPU 检查之前（这正是 u1-l3 说过的「轻量环境也能 `--stats`」的原因）；`--beaker` 在 [olmocr/pipeline.py:L1418-L1420](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1418-L1420) 提交集群任务后同样 `return`，本地不再执行推理。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

并发双闸门。第一道是 worker 数：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1455-L1459](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1455-L1459) —— `for i in range(args.workers)` 创建协程。每个 worker 从队列领一个「PDF 组」处理，默认 20 个组并行推进。

### 4.3 模块三：argparse.SUPPRESS 与条件默认值技巧

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

argparse 的普通 `default` 有个先天局限：**解析结束后属性一定存在**。比如 `default=None` 之后，你无法用 `args.pages_per_group is None` 之外的语义区分「用户没写」和「用户写了但值恰好等值」；更麻烦的是当合法值本身可能是 `0`、`False` 或 `None` 时，`if not args.xxx` 这类判断会把「用户显式传了 0」误判成「没传」。

`argparse.SUPPRESS` 解决了这个问题：**未在命令行提供时，命名空间里干脆不创建这个属性**。于是 `hasattr(args, "pages_per_group")` 成为百分之百可靠的「用户是否显式设置」探测器。olmOCR 用它实现了一个精巧的条件默认值：`pages_per_group` 的最终默认值取决于用户有没有给 `--api_key`。

此外，olmOCR 还展示了另外两个「解析之后再定值」的技巧，合起来构成一个家族：

- `--disk_logging`：`nargs="?"` + `const` + `default=None` 三件套——「不写 flag」是 None，「只写 flag」是 `const` 值，「flag 带值」是那个值。
- `--server`：解析时无默认，随后在 `main()` 里根据它是否存在改写 `args.server` / `args.model`。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`pages_per_group` 的完整生命线：

```text
argparse 定义：default=argparse.SUPPRESS
        ↓
parse_known_args()
        ├─ 用户写了 --pages_per_group N → args.pages_per_group = N（正常属性）
        └─ 用户没写                → args 上【没有】这个属性
        ↓
main() 检查：if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
        ├─ args.api_key is not None（走外部付费 API）→ 默认 50 页/组
        └─ 否则（本地/集群自有算力）      → 默认 500 页/组
        ↓
收集 --pdfs 时：采样最多 100 个 PDF 估算平均页数
        ↓
items_per_group = max(1, int(args.pages_per_group / 平均页数))
        ↓
populate_queue(paths, items_per_group) 切分工作项
```

为什么外部 API 场景要调小？源码注释（L1312-L1313）给了两个理由：一是外部服务商并发限制低，大页组会「压垮服务器」；二是外部 API 按量计费，如果一个页组中途失败重跑，组越大浪费的钱越多。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

SUPPRESS 的定义处：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1220](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1220) —— `--pages_per_group` 的 default 是 `argparse.SUPPRESS`，是全部参数中唯一一个。

```python
parser.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
                    help="Aiming for this many pdf pages per work item group")
```

条件默认值的赋值处（注意它发生在解析之后、任何使用之前）：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1312-L1315](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1312-L1315) —— 注释原话翻译：如果你提供了 API key（意味着你在用远程付费服务商），就调小组大小默认值，免得压垮服务器、也免得组跑不完时浪费钱。

```python
# If you specify an API key, meaning you are on a remote provider, then lower the group size default...
if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
    args.pages_per_group = 50 if args.api_key is not None else 500
```

这个默认值最终被消费的地方：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1398-L1405](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1398-L1405) —— 先随机采样（最多 100 个）PDF 用 pypdf 数页数求平均，再按 `items_per_group = max(1, int(args.pages_per_group / avg_pages_per_pdf))` 计算每组打包几个 PDF。例如平均 10 页/份、目标 500 页/组，则每组约 50 份 PDF。

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L807-L834](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L807-L834) —— 先拼出基础命令（端口、tensor/data parallel、关掉 video 编码器省内存等），再按需追加 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 和 `--max-model-len`（都做了 `is not None` 判断），最后：

```python

    cmd.extend(unknown_args)     # L833-L834：未识别参数原样追加
```

同族技巧之 `--disk_logging`：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1232-L1239](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1232-L1239) —— `nargs="?"` 表示「该选项可以带值也可以不带」；不带值时用 `const` 指定的 `olmocr-pipeline-debug.log`；完全没写这个选项时是 `default` 的 `None`。于是一句 `--disk_logging` 就能开日志，`--disk_logging my.log` 则自定义文件名；消费点在 [L1275-L1280](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1275-L1280)，为两个 logger 挂上 DEBUG 级别的文件 handler。

[olmocr/pipeline.py:L1286](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1286) —— `use_internal_server = not args.server`：提供了 `--server` 就用外部的，没提供就自己启动 vLLM。随后 [L1432-L1433](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1432-L1433) 直接**改写** `args` 命名空间：`args.server = f"http://localhost:{args.port}/v1"`、`args.model = "olmocr"`。下游代码（如构造请求 URL 的 [L161](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L161)）从此不必关心服务器是本地的还是远程的，统一读 `args.server`。`--api_key` 同样只在有 `--server` 时才生效（[L167](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L167)）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用 10 行纯 Python 复现 `argparse.SUPPRESS` + 条件默认值机制，亲眼确认「没写就没有这个属性」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 把下面的脚本存为 `suppress_demo.py`（**示例代码**，不依赖 olmocr，任何 Python 3 均可运行）：

```python
# 示例代码：复现 pipeline.py L1220 与 L1312-L1315 的机制
import argparse

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
parser.add_argument("--api_key", type=str, default=None)

args = parser.parse_args()  # 不带任何参数运行
print("hasattr:", hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"))  # 预期 False

if not hasattr(args, "pages_per_group"):
    args.pages_per_group = 50 if args.api_key is not None else 500
print("条件默认值:", args.pages_per_group)  # 预期 500

# 对照组：普通 default=None 的属性永远存在
p2 = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p2.add_argument("--pages_per_group", type=int, default=None)
print("default=None 时:", vars(p2.parse_args([])))  # 值存在且为 None
```

2. 运行 `python suppress_demo.py`，记下三行输出。
3. 再分别运行 `python suppress_demo.py --pages_per_group 100` 和 `python suppress_demo.py --api_key sk-test`，观察输出如何变化。

**需要观察的现象**：不带参数时 `hasattr` 为 `False`；加了 `--api_key` 后条件默认值变成 50；加了 `--pages_per_group 100` 后 `hasattr` 为 `True` 且值保持 100 不被覆盖。

**预期结果**：三种运行的输出分别对应「本地默认 500」「外部 API 默认 50」「用户显式指定优先」。这正是 [L1312-L1315](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1312-L1315) 的行为模型。（本讲义写作环境未执行脚本，读者本地运行即得结果。）

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果 `--pages_per_group` 改用 `default=None`，再用 `if args.pages_per_group is None` 判断，功能上可行吗？SUPPRESS 的额外价值是什么？

**参考答案**：在本例中功能上可行（None 不是该参数的合法业务值）。SUPPRESS 的额外价值在于通用性：当某参数的合法值可能包含 `0`、`False`、`None` 时，`is None` 或 `if not x` 的哨兵判断会失真，而 `hasattr` 永远准确；它也把「属性不存在」这一信号显式暴露在类型层面，阅读代码的人一眼就知道这里有条件默认值逻辑。

**练习 2**：`olmocr ./ws --pdfs a.pdf --swap-space 4` 能正常运行吗？`--swap-space 4` 去了哪里？

**参考答案**：能。`--swap-space` 不是 olmocr 注册的参数，`parse_known_args()` 把它收进 `unknown_args`；只要这次运行会启动内部 vLLM（没给 `--server`），[L833-L834](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L833-L834) 会把它追加到 `vllm serve` 命令末尾，最终由 vLLM 解释。若用了 `--server` 外部服务，`unknown_args` 则不会被使用（本地不启动 vLLM）。

**练习 3**：`--disk_logging` 不带值、带值、完全不写三种情形下，`args.disk_logging` 分别是什么？

**参考答案**：分别为 `const` 值 `olmocr-pipeline-debug.log`、用户给的值（如 `my.log`）、`default` 值 `None`。三态来自 `nargs="?"` + `const` + `default` 的组合，定义在 [L1232-L1239](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1232-L1239)。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：为三种部署形态各写出一条「带注释的」完整 olmocr 命令，并预填参数表。**

## 6. 本讲小结

- olmOCR 的几十个 CLI 参数定义全部集中在 [pipeline.py:L1200-L1272](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L1200-L1272)，按「顶层输入 / 详细配置 / Server / VLLM / Beaker」分组，恰好对应四种运行形态；`--help` 的分组小节与 `add_argument_group` 一一对应。
- 默认值面向「自有 GPU 大批量」场景：`--workers 20`、`--max_concurrent_requests 1600`、`--pages_per_group` 动态 500；走外部计费 API 时 README 建议显式调小为 `1` / `20`，配合条件默认值 50。
- `parse_known_args()` 收集未识别参数并在启动内部 vLLM 时原样追加到 `vllm serve` 末尾，实现两个工具参数空间的打通；但该转发只在本地启动 vLLM 时生效。

- README 的 `--help` 快照已落后于源码（旧默认模型名、缺 `--api_key`/`--disk_logging` 等参数）；查参数以 argparse 源码为准。
- `--stats`（GPU 检查前）与 `--beaker`（提交后即返回）是两个短路开关，`--workers` 与 `--max_concurrent_requests` 是两道不同粒度的并发闸门。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲结束意味着第 1 单元（认识项目并跑起来）完成。你已经掌握的所有参数，都会在第 2 单元「核心流水线精读」中找到真正的消费现场：

- 下一讲 **u2-l1（pipeline 主流程）**：从 `main()` 全景走一遍——创建 WorkQueue、收集 PDF、启动 vLLM、拉起 `args.workers` 个协程，本讲的参数表就是那张地图的图例。
- 随后的 **u2-l2（输入收集）** 会精读 `--pdfs` 的五种输入形态与 `items_per_group` 的采样估算；**u2-l6（单页处理）** 会用上 `--max_page_retries`；**u2-l8（输出侧）** 对应 `--markdown` 与 `--max_page_error_rate`。
- 如果你被 `--pages_per_group` 的分组机制勾起兴趣，可以先跳读 [olmocr/work_queue.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/work_queue.py) 中 `populate_queue` 的签名，第 3 单元 u3-l1 会正式精读。

Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
